rungs.name: 62 Hz with noise and 4096 count quantisation
rungs.note: condition number 6.3, tolerance 25%. Position quantisation is 1.53 mrad and the servo stiffness is 998 N m per rad, so one count of position error is about 1.53 N m of actuator torque, against a friction signal of roughly 0.05 N m. The method cannot separate them at this rate, and no amount of fitting fixes a signal to noise ratio of 0.04. A partner's bench log with a real torque channel escapes this; a 62 Hz position log does not.
